newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale reset for May 2.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale reset for May 2.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir on Wednesday said the sale of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) had been rescheduled for May 2.
"We will publish a notice on Friday in the Official Journal setting the auction for May 2," Kandir told reporters.

Kandir said the government sent to Brasilia some of the information that a judge at the Superior Court of Justice had requested before he would consider a government appeal against a host of injunctions blocking the sale of the mining company.
The rest of the information would be assembled on Thursday, a public holiday in Brazil, and delivered to the judge on Friday morning.

The judge, Justice Democrito Ramos Reinaldo, had been considering a government petition that a series of injunctions should be judged by a single tribunal because of a "conflict of interpretation" in lower courts.
Kandir said another 10 lawsuits had been filed Wednesday, adding to the 120 or so filed since last Friday.
